cands.name: Vanessa Oliver
cands.bio: Republican from Punta Gorda; lawyer (UF Levin College of Law) and CEO of a medical transportation company; first elected in 2024 to succeed Spencer Roach.
cands.local_ties: Grew up in Charlotte County, returned in 2012, lives in Punta Gorda (Wikipedia). Worklist home county code is CHA.

record.text: Member of the Florida Legislative Aerospace Group. Campaign platform: insurance fraud task force, tax cuts, parental involvement in education, local enforcement of immigration law.

cands.gaps: No finance figures, newspaper endorsements or sponsored-bill list found. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) was NOT run: the shared web-search budget was exhausted, so no owner-source status is known.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
